avalanche.travel_advice: Watch for signs of unstable snow such as recent avalanches, cracking in the snow, and audible collapsing. Avoid traveling on or under similar slopes.

facts: No new snow measured at the 3 nearby stations in the 72 hours to Sep 28.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 21 to 29 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Milk Shakes
evidence.detail: left May 19; earlier seasons: June 6 (2023), June 11 (2024), June 9 (2025)

evidence.name: Touchet
evidence.detail: left April 30; earlier seasons: May 21 (2023), May 16 (2024), May 23 (2025)

evidence.name: High Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 26; earlier seasons: May 27 (2023), May 25 (2024), May 25 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 3 and May 17, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.
